detail.longDescription: Can We Trust Artificial Intelligence With Structural Safety? CALCULATIONS Artificial intelligence is transforming how engineers research technical information, develop design concepts, automate repetitive tasks, and prepare engineering documentation. With a few prompts, a generative AI tool can produce equations, explain structural behaviour, and draft a reinforced concrete beam calculation in seconds.
